registry_disposition.reason: S8 evidence provenance, executed under the owner directive of 2026-10-21 ('S8 Evidence Provenance: ensure that qualification evidence is not legitimized merely through caller claims, but can be traced back to verifiable, immutable execution results'), with the standing invariants 'Approval != Grant' - 'Caller Input != Authority' - 'Receipt != Verification'. The behavioral evidence of the promotion chain was the ONE link that was asserted by the caller instead of recomputed from disk: the promotion input carried the eval record object, its digest and its verdict inline, the record_ref was a free string that was never resolved, the corpus was never consulted and the verdict was taken as given, so a caller could fabricate a schema-valid BehavioralEvalRecord with verdict IMPROVEMENT_PROVEN and the chain accepted it. The slice closes that gap with the new runtime module scripts/tools/evidence-provenance.mjs and the new canonical contract core/contracts/evidence-provenance.schema.json: the record is READ from the canonical evidence surface (a caller-supplied record object is refused outright), the record must satisfy its own content seal, the corpus is resolved in the tree and re-hashed from disk, the evaluation is RE-EXECUTED over that corpus and must reproduce the record field for field, and the comparison AND the verdict AND the baseline reference are RE-DERIVED from the baseline record on disk. The attestation is carried by the contract with execution_rederived and comparison_rederived as const true, the post-adoption readback re-VERIFIES the bound evidence instead of merely re-reading it, and the CLI pins the evidence tree of its own installation so an input file can neither redirect the evidence nor widen a gate. The slice also amends core/contracts/skill-promotion-adoption.schema.json (its eval_evidence block now carries provenance attestations and a corpus_ref), the S5 producer scripts/tools/run-skill-effectiveness-evals.mjs (a BLOCKED candidate now names its baseline, which the canonical contract required and the producer never wrote), and scripts/tools/experiment-comparison-evidence.mjs (the instruction-binding artifact of the HO-01 run bundles is now inside the run-evidence digest, which makes the previous run's claim that the projection covers it true). Two live defects were found by the new gate and are repaired in the same change: the SHIPPED behavioral evidence of 2026-10-20 no longer reproduces, because the S7 slice changed the corpus about six hours after those records were sealed and the evidence was never re-issued (the evidence is re-issued under evidence/skill-effectiveness-evals-2026-10-21/, the superseded evidence is kept and annotated, and the staleness is bound by a test that asserts the refusal); and the frontdoor admission of the same chain is still a caller-supplied file at an arbitrary path, which is recorded as a residual of the frontdoor lane and NOT changed here. Two further residuals are recorded and not repaired: the freshness bound is a DECLARED property (the content seal is unkeyed and does not cover created_at, so an editor of the evidence tree can re-date a record; a future-dated record is now refused and the bound is stated honestly), and the corpus is not bound to the ADOPTED CONTENT (the corpus names its subject by label; the binding needs a subject-content digest that the behavioral eval contract of the S5 lane does not carry). The scope boundary is explicit: the specification stays PROPOSED, this slice adopts nothing, promotes no skill, activates no runtime, qualifies no model and no executor, grants no permission and changes no authority. The canonical owner trust anchor is unchanged and still publishes no key, so no approval can authorize a promotion and the chain still refuses at OWNER_AUTHORITY_NOT_PUBLISHED; the bounded promotion acceptance remains an owner act. This disposition is REQUIRED_BUT_BLOCKED at publication because the Registry write itself has not happened yet: the run change registration registry/MAWS_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_2026_10_21_001.yaml and the contract record registry/MAWS_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_CONTRACT_2026_10_21_001.yaml are published in a follow-up pull request of this repository, and the owner-side classification is rebound from REQUIRED_BUT_BLOCKED to UPDATED with the registry commit sha after that write.
